title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot Agent Mode creates executive summary slides
summary: Hold: the briefing overlooks published requirements for Copilot in PowerPoint on the web and describes a broader Graph permission as mandatory when Microsoft allows alternatives. Microsoft also documents a general deployment model for Copilot features, contrary to the statement that rollout mechanics are unstated. The roadmap facts, licence-assignment path and command are supported.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: A user's licences can be assigned in Microsoft 365 admin center at Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: Users > Active users; Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence to the specified user.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Licence assignment in Microsoft 365 admin center requires at least a License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The Graph PowerShell licence-assignment route needs the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.
claims.fix: Replace the permission clause with 'The Graph PowerShell route accepts User.ReadWrite.All or another permission listed in the Assign license reference; LicenseAssignment.ReadWrite.All is the least-privileged permission.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-assignlicense, whose permissions table lists that least-privileged scope for delegated and application access.
